# ZORR 30s BATTLE PRODUCTION MASTER

SOURCE = explicit OWNER correction, 2026-09-12
ROLE = CURRENT PRODUCT ROUTER
TARGET = repeatable ~30-second vertical anime battle shorts for social audience growth

## PRODUCT GOAL

The studio loop is now:

`SCENARIO -> STORYBOARD/LAYOUT -> KEY POSES + BREAKDOWNS -> RIFE INBETWEENS -> DAVINCI RESOLVE/FUSION -> SOUND/QC -> RELEASE -> LEARN -> NEXT SHORT`

The product is an approximately 30-second battle short. The old `10s-first` product target is superseded. A 30-second short may be internally divided into 3 x ~10-second production blocks for organization only; those blocks are NOT independent gates and production must continue through the full short unless a real blocker exists.

## CONTENT TARGET

Current default format:
- K1 = strong humanoid character;
- K2 = dangerous creature/monster;
- immediate readable confrontation;
- hook/scroll-stop within ~2 seconds;
- conflict readable without sound within ~3–5 seconds;
- several short action bursts rather than continuous expensive animation;
- initiative shift / escalation / reversal;
- 2–4 iconic fashion/psychedelic hero poses;
- one memorable payoff, cliffhanger or replay beat;
- beautiful, graphic, high-contrast vertical composition.

Transferable study DNA may draw from principles associated with BLEACH, Afro Samurai and JoJo — negative space/restraint, quiet-before-burst lethal economy, fashion-driven poses/graphic freezes — but production must remain original ZORR BLATT and must not copy specific scenes, frames, characters or exact styles.

## PRODUCTION LAW

Limited animation is the base, not a fallback.

`KEYS / POSES / HOLDS / CUTS / CAMERA / FX` carry most of the scene.

RIFE/Flowframes is used selectively for short, visually close transitions where smoothness adds value. It is not used blindly across major pose changes, occlusion, new revealed form, strong rotation, contact, grappling, impact frames or cuts.

DaVinci Resolve + Fusion is the assembly/composite/edit/sound/master environment.

Critical path must not depend on Seedance or paid video-generation services.

HOME-PC baseline: Ryzen 5 7535HS, 16 GB RAM, RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB VRAM.

## STAGE CONTRACT

### P01 — SCENARIO
Deliverable: one production-ready ~30s script/handoff with exact timeline, social hook, action logic, location/character requirements, shot plan, key/breakdown plan, RIFE windows, VFX/SFX/edit rhythm and asset count.

### P02 — STORYBOARD / LAYOUT
Deliverable: complete vertical 9:16 shot sequence with exact timing, screen direction, camera/layout, value masses, negative space, poses and action axis.

### P03 — KEY FRAME GENERATION
Deliverable: approved key/extreme frames and required semantic breakdowns. Strong pose readability and identity continuity outrank smoothness.

### P04 — RIFE / INBETWEEN
Deliverable: only bounded safe interpolation intervals. Bad interpolated frames are locally replaced; accepted keys remain frozen. Never interpolate across a cut.

### P05 — DAVINCI / FUSION
Deliverable: exact timeline assembly, holds/exposures, pans/reframes, masks, impact accents, flashes/shake, VFX, grade/value treatment, sound and rhythm.

### P06 — QC / RELEASE
Deliverable: final vertical master with exact duration/FPS, no identity drift, no broken interpolation, readable action, working hook/payoff, safe framing and export suitable for social release.

### P07 — LEARN / NEXT
After each released or fully evaluated short, persist only useful lessons: what held attention, what was expensive, what failed visually, which RIFE intervals worked, which poses/compositions were strongest. Apply 1–3 concrete improvements to the next short. Research serves the next production decision; it must not replace production.

## HANDOFF LAW

A scenario ZIP/DOCX handoff is an execution input. A new production chat performs only the minimum authority check necessary to ensure no current contradiction, then immediately executes the first unfinished production step. Bootstrap/status is not a valid end product. Do not redesign an approved handoff without explicit OWNER instruction or a proven contradiction.

OWNER should not have to type `continue` between obvious production stages.

## REPOSITORY INTEGRATION STATUS

Candidate integration PR = #275, head `owner/30s-battle-pipeline-r01`.

Until PR #275 is merged, the issue itself is the current OWNER product router, while the following file changes are CANDIDATE / NOT YET MAIN:
- `studio/ZORR_30S_BATTLE_PIPELINE_R01.md`;
- `studio/ZORR_30S_CHAT_STARTERS_R01.md`;
- `AGENTS.md` 30s router pointer;
- `ZORR_EXECUTION_CONSTITUTION.md` 30s production law.

Do not claim those file changes are on `main` until fresh evidence proves the merge.

## SUPERSEDED ROUTE

Issue #251 is closed and superseded as a duration router. It remains historical evidence for the useful key/breakdown/inbetween architecture. Do not resurrect its old 10s-first gate.

## NEXT

After repository integration, every new production chat should use the same loop:

`SCENARIO -> STORYBOARD -> KEYS/BREAKDOWNS -> RIFE -> DAVINCI -> QC -> RELEASE -> LEARN`.
